newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam bourse to evaluate its trading system.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam bourse to evaluate its trading system.

text.p: The Amsterdam Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it had started an extensive survey to evaluate its trading system.
When the system was launched in 1994, it was decided to have an evaluation three years later among all parties concerned.

The bourse said it had hired an independent research firm to make enquiries both in the Netherlands and abroad among direct users of the trading system and among other players. These included market makers at Amsterdam's AEX Options Exchange, investors and non-Dutch intermediaries.
The findings of these enquiries will be evaluated by a number of bourse committees before the end of this summer.
The bourse said its management board would decide this autumn if any changes to the trading system were necessary.
